title: Turkish-Style Tempeh Borek
description: A keto take on the traditional Turkish pastry, filled with marinated tempeh and spices.

ingredients.name: Tempeh
ingredients.notes: marinated in 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika

ingredients.name: Intricately shredded cheese
ingredients.notes: such as feta or goat cheese

instructions: Roll out the borek dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut the dough into squares of about 4 inches per side.
Place a tablespoon of the marinated tempeh in the center of each square.
Add a sprinkle of intricately shredded cheese, garlic, Turkish red pepper flakes, and salt on top of the tempeh.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or square shape, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the borek with olive oil.
Bake the borek in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
